mapper.sql: g.id, g.name, g.subtitle, g.cover, g.price, g.original_price, g.stock, g.sales, g.is_handmade, g.category_id, g.craftsman_id, c.name AS category_name, cs.real_name AS craftsman_name, cs.craft_type AS craft_type, rv.rating_avg AS rating_avg, rv.review_count AS review_count
mapper.update: UPDATE goods SET view_count = view_count + #{delta}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.name, g.cover, g.stock, g.price, g.sales, c.name AS category_name FROM goods g LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = g.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE g.deleted = 0 AND g.craftsman_id = #{craftsmanId} AND g.status = 1 AND g.audit_status = 1 AND g.stock <= #{threshold} ORDER BY g.stock ASC, g.sales DESC
mapper.update:
UPDATE goods SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE deleted = 0 AND craftsman_id = #{craftsmanId} AND audit_status = 1 AND id IN
#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.name, g.subtitle, g.cover, g.description, g.detail, g.price, g.original_price, g.stock, g.sales, g.view_count, g.is_handmade, g.status, g.audit_status, g.reject_reason, g.category_id, g.craftsman_id, g.create_time, g.update_time, c.name AS category_name, cr.real_name AS craftsman_name, cr.craft_type AS craft_type, u.phone AS craftsman_phone, rv.rating_avg AS rating_avg, rv.review_count AS review_count FROM goods g LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = g.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN craftsman cr ON cr.id = g.craftsman_id AND cr.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = cr.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT target_id, ROUND(AVG(rating), 1) AS rating_avg, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM review WHERE type = 1 AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY target_id ) rv ON rv.target_id = g.id WHERE g.deleted = 0 AND g.id = #{id}
